auditor: Independent D3 guard / billing subagent; separate from response-quality judgments
scope: Stored provider usage.cost, result costs, session/global ledgers, planned jobs, saved route metadata, and source/runner hashes. No API key files or model response prose inspected for this audit.

authorization.round2And3PrecisionNote: Floating-point sums are compared with 1e-10 USD tolerance; each per-call usage/result/two-ledger amount was compared exactly.

oneToOneEvidence.automaticRetryEvidence: Every manifest disables retry; one planned job/result/session charge/global charge and unique provider generation ID per call; reviewed Engine.generate has one POST and no automatic retry loop.

limitations: No provider billing dashboard or external invoice reconciliation was performed. The audit verifies the persisted provider usage and local evidence.
This audit does not evaluate character response quality or treat code review as blinded quality evaluation.
